description: Training-time metrics from the offline wandb runs (train_adsrl.py log_train): train/ep_rew_mean (mean return of the episodes finished in the log window; reward is -1 per step until success) and train/success_rate (fraction of training envs that succeeded in the window). Rolling mean over 2% of each task's plotted range, then mean +- SE over seeds; runs below 50% of the furthest seed in their group are excluded. Every 5th grid point is stored here.
